`/sjck-change` isn't installed in this session, so it didn't run. To plan a task, use **`/sjck-graph:sjck-plan`**. It asks you a few targeted questions, compares alternatives with cost and time estimates, suggests ways to save effort, and writes a plan you can run with `/sjck-graph:sjck-run`. Planning doesn't touch code; it only writes under `.sjck/`.

You can run that command with your task description, or just tell me the task here and I'll start the planning flow. For example: "add pose logging to the recorder" or "split the ROS bridge into publishers and subscribers."

Your working tree already has a `.sjck/` directory and uncommitted changes, including a new `uw/pose.py`. If this task continues that work, say so and I'll check the existing state first. You can also do that yourself with `/sjck-graph:sjck-status`.
